resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (Certificate of Continued Occupancy) inspection
resale_co.issued_by: Housing Inspector / Housing Officer, Greenwich Township Construction Office
requirements: Yard clean, no trash, debris, junk or junk cars; lawn mowed
Exterior in good repair, no chipped paint or corrosion
House numbers visible from the street (3 or 4 inch depending on setback)
Handrails and guards on all stairways; basement stair openings blocked so no fall-through
Doors and windows in good condition; windows open smoothly, have screens, stay open; no broken glass
Bathrooms have a window or mechanical ventilation
GFI outlets in bathrooms, kitchens and laundry rooms within 6 ft of a water source; at least two outlets per room
Smoke alarm on each floor: 10-year sealed battery unit unless hard-wired with battery backup
Carbon monoxide alarm if heat or hot water is gas or oil fired
Water heater in good condition with relief valve discharge pipe ending 6 inches from floor; toilets and plumbing with no leaks; adequate water pressure
Oil-fired heater inspected within last 2 years; wood fireplaces or stoves cleaned and inspected by a licensed chimney sweep
Electric service in good condition, no bare wires or missing box covers; oil tanks not leaking
Sidewalks with no raised sections over 1 inch; sheds, garages and fences in good condition
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Occupancy (mark it Resale and give the settlement date) and submit it to the Construction Office at 420 Washington Street, Gibbstown, with the fee (form lists cash or check). The application is not complete until the owner or realtor calls the office to schedule the inspection: ext. 201 (Kay Hewes) or ext. 214 (inspection officer). Inspections are done Tuesdays and Thursdays, 10 AM to 2 PM. The Spring 2026 township newsletter says Certification of Continued Occupancy fees can also be paid online.

evidence.quote: RESALE: RENTAL: OTHER: SETTLEMENT/OCCUPANCY DATE: ... THIS DWELLING IS NOT TO BE OCCUPIED UNTIL A CERTIFICATE OF OCCUPANCY IS ISSUED BY THE HOUSING INSPECTOR OF GREENWICH TOWNSHIP.
Certificates of Occupancy Inspections CO inspections will be conducted on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10AM and 2PM unless an emergent situation exists.
CO will not be issued if home has any open construction permits that are pending.

resale_co.notes: The township code (ecode360 GR0428) could not be opened, so the ordinance text requiring the CO on resale was not read directly. Requirement is shown by the official application form, which has a Resale option and says the dwelling may not be occupied until the Housing Inspector issues a CO. The township also has a landlord registration and rental property code (Ord. 21-2009) for rentals, and a lead paint ordinance (Ord. 2-2023). The checklist is dated Rev. 6/14/21. Online payment of CCO and fire inspection fees is announced in the Spring 2026 newsletter (Edmunds payment portal).

requirements: Township CO checklist (Rev. 6/14/21) asks for a 10-year sealed battery smoke alarm on each floor unless hard-wired with battery backup, and a 2-A:10-B:C extinguisher; these are CO checklist items, not a published fire bureau rule

authorities.name: Greenwich Township Fire Official (municipal local enforcing agency)
authorities.how_to_apply: Contact the township Fire Official. The Spring 2026 newsletter says fire inspection fees can be paid online through the township payment portal.

fire_cert.notes: DCA LEA Registry (Third Quarter, July 2026) lists Greenwich Township, Gloucester County as 'M' (the municipality is the local enforcing agency). Key: 'M = Municipality'. The township website's Fire link redirects to the volunteer fire company site (gibbstownfire.com), which is behind a bot check and was not read. No published smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate fee or application form was found on an official source. Note: search results about Bridgeton being the LEA for 'Greenwich' refer to Greenwich Township in Cumberland County, not this town.

other_items.label: Open construction permits must be closed
other_items.detail: CO checklist: 'CO will not be issued if home has any open construction permits that are pending.'

open_questions: Smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate fee and application process for the Greenwich Township Fire Official were not published on any official page found.
Ordinance text for the resale CO (lead time, validity, late fees) is on ecode360 and could not be read.
Whether the Housing Inspector's CO inspection also serves as the fire certificate, or a separate Fire Official certificate is needed, is not stated.
